question: Does the self-contained field CLI reproduce the installed assistant on all four real tool providers while retaining the qualified tool, language and physical 128K behavior?
protocol: One export with pinned Base language weights and dedicated quantized recurrent tool weights. Explicit tool list selects the tool model; only one backbone is retained when switching. Re-execute all 22 BFCL numeric sessions and require identical input/output IDs and actual observations. Ask five native version questions answered only with real importlib.metadata calls. Replay the first in a network-off isolated bundled-runtime interpreter. Check exact short streams+routes on 64 induction/56 deduction/80 mixed prompts, all 120 raw prose routes and exact aggregate/domain NLL. End with both physical 131083-token counterfactual generations. Accuracy or token mismatch stops dependent checks. Record any field-floor failure after the mandatory language replays. Bundle four actual local tool providers and compare exact status, visible answer and all token IDs, actions and observations with the installed command in separate fresh processes. Use the checkpoint-specific prefix default precisely when its sealed crossover passes. Test one package version, catalog lookup, arithmetic product and database maximum. Publish independently scored field outcomes even for consistent mistakes.
gate: All 22 tool and 200 language trajectories exact, identical isolated offline trace, >=4/5 correct tool-grounded field answers, exact NLL across 9328 targets, both full-history outputs and correct evidence spans exact, combined long decode <=688.10 seconds (1.75x archived untouched Base). Stop on memory or wall limit. Require all four installed/isolated field trajectories exactly identical. Field correctness on these four cases is descriptive. A mismatch closes publication of this revision.
